item.title: Version 1.8
item.description:
AI playlists and macOS integration

  • Moved AI playlist creation into a dedicated toolbar action.
  • Added inference-server availability checks and provider-mismatch guidance.
  • Made the menu-bar player appear only while AuDeluxe is minimized, with reliable window and Dock restoration.
  • Presented Settings modally and clarified the automatic app-release check.
